identity.name: Royal Palm Yacht & Country Club
identity.notes: Prestigious limited-access, gated community in Boca Raton (33432) of approximately 742 lots / ~680 homes on a 450-acre layout with waterfront, golf-course, and interior lots. Gated via a private motor court with 24/7 armed security patrols and guarded entrances. The official HOA, RPIA (1650 S. Dixie Highway, Suite 100, Boca Raton, FL 33432; rpia.net), enforces architectural standards. Median sold price rose from $3.4M (2017) to $9M (2026). The private Royal Palm Yacht & Country Club (since 1959) offers optional membership with yacht club, marina, country club, golf, tennis, wellness center, and dining.

Elegant venue for everyday member dining and special events. Flexible spaces host events from 4 to almost 400 guests. Features two meeting spaces, wine room with sampling space, terrace dining, fire pit, and commanding view of the marina. Year-round calendar of social events and activities.

Renovated pool with new gazebo, saline chlorination system for softer swim. Includes wading pool and water features for toddlers. Host to club parties, youth events, and weddings. Ideal for laps and water aerobics.
Five tennis courts active with tennis teams, kids programs, and clinics for all experience levels.

Personal training, group exercise classes, pilates, and spa services. Cardio and weights area, personal training studio, group exercise studio, and dedicated pilates area with towers and reformers. Hosts nutrition and health lectures, demonstrations, and guest speakers.

Built around golf. Features a Pro Shop adjacent to the 19th Hole with course and water feature views. Spacious Men's and Women's locker rooms. Shoe service, custom and special orders from the Golf Shop, and pro tips available on the shop's astroturf.
The club was built around golf, with a 19th Hole bar and views of the course.

Dedicated kids' room within the Yacht Club with hand-painted Florida wildlife mural, chalkboard wall, gaming stations, and dedicated restroom. Home base for Junior Palmer events, camps, kids' nights, and S.T.E.A.M. program led by a Youth Activities Director.

Jack Nicklaus signature golf course; 221 golf course homesites in the community; golf among listed outdoor amenities. Developed by Arvida Corporation from Arthur Vining Davis's land holdings (1958). Contact: (561) 368-6200, 741 East Palmetto Park Road, Boca Raton, FL 33432. Homeownership is separate from club membership and not mandatory; RPYCC Homeowner's Association (RPIA) at www.RPIA.net; Membership Services contact Michael Shanely, (561) 210-8146, mshanley@rpycc.org.

World-class yachting facility with direct Ocean and Intracoastal access; 229 waterfront/Intracoastal homesites. RPYCC is described as South Florida's most prestigious neighborhood where the past meets the present. Community includes 299 interior, 221 golf course, and 229 waterfront/Intracoastal homesites, with ocean swimming, fishing, golf and tennis available. Contact: david@royalpalm.com / nicholas@royalpalm.com, (561) 368-6200.

Direct Ocean access for swimming; the community has acres with direct Ocean and Intracoastal access. RPYCC is conveniently located in East Boca Raton, directly across from The Boca Raton Resort & Club, and minutes from fantastic shopping and fine dining in Mizner Park.
